# opnsense_trust_crl (Resource)

Certificate revocation list of a certificate authority (**System ▸ Trust ▸ Revocation**). With `method = "internal"`, OPNsense signs the list with the CA's private key and lists the `revoked` certificates; with `method = "existing"`, the list given in `import_pem` is stored as is. There is one list per CA.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_trust_crl" "internal" {
  ca          = opnsense_trust_ca.internal.ref_id
  description = "Internal CA revocations"
  revoked = [
    { certificate = opnsense_trust_cert.lost_laptop.ref_id, reason = "keyCompromise" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ca` (String) Reference ID of the CA, e.g. `opnsense_trust_ca.internal.ref_id`.
- `description` (String) Description of the list.

### Optional

- `import_pem` (String) PEM-encoded CRL to store, with `method = "existing"`.
- `lifetime` (Number) Validity of a generated list, in days. Defaults to `9999`.
- `method` (String) `internal` (generated and signed by OPNsense, needs the CA's private key) or `existing` (imported from `import_pem`). Defaults to `internal`.
- `revoked` (Attributes Set) Certificates revoked by a generated list. Defaults to `[]`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--revoked))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `ca`.
- `pem` (String) Current list, PEM-encoded.
- `serial` (String) Serial number of the list, increased by OPNsense on every change.

<a id="nestedatt--revoked"></a>
### Nested Schema for `revoked`

Required:

- `certificate` (String) Reference ID of the certificate, e.g. `opnsense_trust_cert.laptop.ref_id`.
- `reason` (String) Revocation reason: `unspecified`, `keyCompromise`, `cACompromise`, `affiliationChanged`, `superseded`, `cessationOfOperation` or `certificateHold`.
